title: Send an offer to a renter
summary: Renter, dates, car, coverage, then send: the renter gets the link to approve, sign and pay.

steps.text: Open Send an offer (Requests, Send an offer without a request).
Find the renter by name, phone or email, or press Not on file? Add a new customer and type their name, mobile, email and date of birth.
Set when they pick up and return the car.
Choose the car. Each car says whether it is free for these dates.
Pickup and return are at our location unless you deliver or collect the car. A delivery fee is added for you.
Ask the renter how damage is covered: their own insurance, their credit card, or our Protection Plan.
Choose who found this client: I sourced this client, or Entered for CarmaCars.
Check Ready to send, then press Send the offer. The renter gets the link by email and text.
